datasets.title: UCI-45 Cleveland / DA-A2
known_facts: Official sources define age, sex, cp, trestbps and restecg and give trestbps as resting blood pressure on admission in mm Hg.
UCI class vector is 164/55/36/35/13; 139 positive versus 164 negative under 0 vs 1-4 binarization (E4 arithmetic).
num is 0 <50% and 1 >50% diameter narrowing; exact 50% is undefined by the primary sources.
Original 1989 study used 303 Cleveland angiography patients and showed site-dependent calibration errors.
uncertainties: No dated per-field evidence that all five proposed inputs existed before the reference procedure.
No primary ruling on exact-50 records or equivalence with UCI-412 >=50%.
Historical paper cohort cannot be proven identical row-for-row to the delivered processed file.
Cross-site patient overlap cannot be excluded from dummy-identifier public metadata.
leakage_risks: ca and raw per-vessel fields 59-68 are components of the angiographic label and are prohibited pre-test predictors.
thal and the exercise-test block have unresolved acquisition timing.
Applying 1989 historical accuracy or AUROC to the five-field proposed panel would conflate different models and feature sets.

recommendation.rationale: Owner definitions are explicit and reviewable, but five-field pre-test timing and threshold equivalence remain unresolved; no D-047 reinterpretation or new study is authorized.

decision_requirements.requirement: Obtain original acquisition documentation with dated, field-level timing for age, sex, cp, trestbps and restecg.
Rule on exact-50 coding and strict >50% versus >=50% equivalence without silent harmonization.
Separately approve any frozen Cleveland development protocol and artifact SHA before an external role is considered.
decision_requirements.owner: Named human governance and scientific reviewers

datasets.title: UCI-45 Hungary
known_facts: Official UCI class vector is 188/37/26/28/15: 294 records, 188 negative and 106 positive (E4 arithmetic).
The 1989 original abstract describes a separate 425-patient Hungarian test group at 38% prevalence, not the delivered 294-record count.
E2 historical local audit reports 292/294 joint availability for the five resting fields and 782 recognized missing cells in 14 processed columns.
UCI-45 is displayed as CC BY 4.0; repository policy still forbids committing patient-level files.
uncertainties: Patient-level independence from Cleveland cannot be established from public metadata with dummy identifiers.
Processed binary labels are consistent with raw 0-4 binarization at aggregate level but clinical equivalence is unverified.
No field-level timestamp demonstrates pre-angiography availability of the five inputs.
No locked Cleveland artifact or approved precision estimand exists, so Riley-style adequacy is unassessed.
leakage_risks: Using Hungary outcomes for feature, preprocessing, calibration or model selection would convert it from an assessment set to development data.
Missing-input imputation or recoding learned after a locked test would leak assessment information.
ca and other angiography-derived fields remain prohibited despite their availability in the shared schema.

recommendation.rationale: Hungary is the highest-priority candidate for a future separately approved frozen one-shot assessment, but independence, target equivalence, timing, precision and approvals are all unresolved.
recommendation.decision_owner: Named clinical/scientific reviewer, statistician, maintainer and local operator

decision_requirements.requirement: Document site/owner provenance and an overlap disposition; do not infer independence from site names or non-matching profiles.
Rule on endpoint equivalence including raw 0-4 to processed 0/1 mapping and exact-50 handling.
Approve a five-field dictionary with units, categories, timestamps, sentinels and a missing-input policy before any scoring.
Freeze a separately approved Cleveland model and preprocessing pipeline with exact SHA-256; then approve a one-shot protocol/ledger and named local authorization.
decision_requirements.owner: Named human governance reviewers and local operator

decision_requirements.requirement: Write a Riley-style precision feasibility decision with prespecified estimands, CI widths, prevalence, calibration and linear-predictor assumptions.

datasets.title: UCI-145 Statlog (Heart)
known_facts: Official owner page lists 270 instances, 13 features, target 1 absence / 2 presence, no missing values and a similar-but-different-form description referencing UCI Heart Disease.
UCI Statlog Project page says the heart database has 13 attributes extracted from a larger set of 75 and belongs to the European StatLog comparative project.
E3 sources describe Cleveland Clinic origin and a proper-subset hypothesis of 270 within 303 records.
uncertainties: Official owner documentation does not confirm patient-level overlap or independence.
No official stenosis threshold or reference standard is printed for the 1/2 target.
The subset claim is an E3 hypothesis and was search-excerpt-only in this pass.
leakage_risks: Probable duplication with Cleveland would inflate any train/test or external-validation metric.
The ca-equivalent fluoroscopy field and thal timing carry the same pre-test restrictions as UCI-45.
Kaggle merged copies that include Statlog and Cleveland are duplicate-suspect and are not acquisition sources.

recommendation.rationale: Statlog cannot be treated as independent validation or pooled data while overlap is unresolved; a scoped lineage/duplicate review is legitimate but does not grant study use.

decision_requirements.requirement: Obtain original Statlog project or donor documentation naming the heart cohort and its relationship to Cleveland.
Perform privacy-preserving exact and near-duplicate overlap analysis on shared stable fields only under a separately recorded authorization.
Record a clinical target/threshold ruling and either exclude Statlog or relabel any analysis as sensitivity, never independent validation.

datasets.title: UCI-411 Extension of Z-Alizadeh Sani
known_facts: Official page states 303 patients, 59 features and an extension adding LAD, LCX and RCA.
Owner text says CAD occurs when at least one of those arteries is stenotic and only one of LAD/LCX/RCA/Cath may be retained for classification.
UCI-412 owner page describes the same 303-patient baseline with a >=50% definition, creating the existing cross-family threshold contrast with UCI-45 >50%.
uncertainties: Row-level one-to-one correspondence with UCI-412 was not examined here.
Owner file-version reconciliation is outside this report.
leakage_risks: LAD, LCX, RCA and Cath are outcome-defining artery fields and are target leakage as pre-test predictors.
Using 411 as validation of a 412 model reuses the same patients, events and angiographic result.
Adding 303 extension rows to 303 baseline rows would falsely double the sample size.

recommendation.rationale: The extension changes the feature dictionary of the same 303 participants and cannot supply independent validation; overlap study remains the only legitimate role.
recommendation.decision_owner: Scientific reviewer and authorized local auditor

decision_requirements.requirement: Maintain the canonical exclusion of UCI-411 from independent validation, pooled training and sample-size totals.
If version reconciliation is pursued, use a separately authorized privacy-preserving same-cohort correspondence audit; never treat absence of row proof as independence.

datasets.title: UCI-45 VA Long Beach
known_facts: Official UCI class vector is 51/56/41/42/10: 200 records, 149 positive (E4 arithmetic), attributed to Robert Detrano.
The original abstract reports a 200-patient VA group at 75% prevalence and a >50% epicardial-vessel endpoint.
E2 local audit reports 698 recognized missing cells in 14 processed columns, including ca=198/200, thal=166/200, slope=102/200 and trestbps=56/200.
uncertainties: Similar counts and prevalence do not prove that delivered records are the original publication subjects.
Exact-50 coding, site reference standard and cross-site patient independence are unverified.
A five-field pre-test timestamp and site-specific delivered-file units are not documented.
No approved missingness/abstention policy or locked-model precision estimand exists.
leakage_risks: ca is angiography-derived and must remain excluded despite its missingness.
Imputing from the assessment cohort or selecting a rule after seeing outcomes would leak test information.
Pooling with Cleveland would confound site and patient identity unless overlap is ruled out.

recommendation.rationale: VA has a compatible source wording and case count for a limited domain-shift/missingness question, but no approved role, endpoint ruling, precision design or independent-patient evidence.

decision_requirements.requirement: Complete source-pair overlap and target-semantics review before any comparison.
Prespecify missing-input, zero/negative-value and abstention rules without using assessment outcomes.
Write a precision decision and explicit governance authorization naming VA and its limited role before any evaluation.

datasets.title: UCI-45 Switzerland
known_facts: Official UCI class vector is 8/48/32/30/5: 123 records, 115 positive and only 8 negative (E4 arithmetic).
The original abstract reports 143 Swiss patients at 84% prevalence; the E3 transcription splits 58 Zurich and 85 Basel in 1985, so the delivered 123-record file is not the full published group.
E2 local audit reports 273 recognized missing cells in 14 columns, ca=118/123, fbs=75/123, thal=52/123 and chol=0 in all 123 rows, an unresolved structural-missingness/coding question.
uncertainties: The 123 versus 143 relationship and exact Zurich/Basel attribution of the delivered subset are unverified.
No primary source explains chol=0 or certifies five-field pre-angiography timing.
Cross-patient independence and site-specific reference-standard details are unresolved.
Exact precision cannot be computed without a frozen model and prespecified estimands.
leakage_risks: The eight negatives are too few to support many precise specificity or calibration claims and must not be used for tuning.
Recoding chol=0 after seeing assessment results would be an unapproved outcome-informed transformation.
ca and other angiography-derived fields remain excluded.

recommendation.rationale: Severe unresolved missingness, case-enrichment with only eight negatives and a 123-versus-143 subset mismatch make this unsuitable as a primary locked external validation; a descriptive suitability/stress role needs explicit review.

decision_requirements.requirement: Reconcile the 123-record UCI file with the 143-patient publication group and site attribution using owner/version evidence.
Rule on chol=0 and all missingness/abstention semantics before any modeling consideration.
Record a written precision disposition; if infeasible, label the result NO-GO rather than real validation.
